name: EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival 2027
summary: First pass from research. The 2027 festival (Mar 10 - May 31) has dates but no menus yet, so every Outdoor Kitchen and dish here is the 2026 festival's, read from Disney's own 2026 Foodie Guide, with 2026 prices from BlogMickey and WDWNT where either posted them (14 kitchens had none). EPCOT Farmers Feast's seasonal menus say which season in the description. Garden Graze dishes are labelled.
location_notes: Every booth's location is Disney's own 'Location:' line. A kitchen in a pavilion that also hosts a Food & Wine marketplace is pinned on that marketplace's pin at 'anchored' precision, and says so in `pinned_from`; Refreshment Outpost, Tangierine Café and Swirled Showcase are the same venues as in Food & Wine and reuse their pins.
Unplaced: kitchens on the walkways and near Test Track, The Odyssey, Port of Entry and Disney Traders, the Land kiosk, Norway and the United Kingdom, Connections Eatery and Sunshine Seasons.

next_step: Disney published 2026's guide on Feb 19. When the 2027 guide lands, re-check every dish in the Studio and add the guide to photo_pages.
photo_pages_note: Read by `epcot-fw festival photos`, newest first. Disney rewrites one guide per festival each year; add next year's guide here when it is published and re-run: its photos replace these, dish by dish.
photo_pages_older: Checked 2023-2025 via Internet Archive copies of Disney's guides (web.archive.org): each kitchen had one group photo, never a photo per dish, so none can be attached to a dish. Per-dish photos start with the 2026 guide.
